datasheet_identity.title: K12 THRU K110 1.0AMP SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIERS

extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is a family sheet covering K12 through K110; K14 is identified by the K14 column and the shared K12-K14 forward-characteristics curve.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification; Schottky reverse recovery is not specified.
The reverse-leakage table value is 0.2 mA at the rated DC blocking voltage and TA = 25 degC; converted to 0.0002 A.
The typical junction-capacitance table value is 110 pF at 1 MHz and 4.0 V reverse voltage; converted to 1.1e-10 F.
Curve points are manually digitized from the supplied plots and retain the plotted axis scales and stated conditions.
omission_reason: No reverse-recovery, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification is published for this Schottky rectifier family.
